
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Fills a one-dimensional single-precision complex floating-point ndarray with
    linearly spaced numeric elements which increment by `1` starting from a
    specified value.

    The input ndarray is modified *in-place* (i.e., the input ndarray is
    *mutated*).

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a one-dimensional input ndarray and a
        zero-dimensional ndarray containing a starting value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/complex64}}( [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ] );
    > var dt = 'complex64';
    > var sh = [ 2 ];
    > var sx = [ 1 ];
    > var ox = 0;
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/ctor}}( dt, xbuf, sh, sx, ox, ord );
    > var s = new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float32/ctor}}( 3.0, 0.0 );
    > var start = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/base/from-scalar}}( s, dt, ord );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, start ] )
    <ndarray>[ <Complex64>[ 3.0, 0.0 ], <Complex64>[ 4.0, 0.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
